passages.text:
Re: YouTube
[contact omitted] Vera Zakem Wednesday, July 27, 2022 at 11:13:50 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Nils Mueller
So so great to chat with you! Let's pick up our conversation!
On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 8:03 AM Nils Mueller <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Sounds great. Thanks Josh and team! Exciting to seethis move forward.
Nils M. Mueller
Director, General Development Office
Regional Development Mission for Asia (RDMA)
US Agency for International Development (USAID)
[contact omitted]
On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 8:52 PM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
For sure. RDMA and Internews seem very interested. They will have a concept ready next week to share with
YouTube.
Best, Josh
On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 3:50 PM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]>wrote:
That's great. Can I let them know that there is an interest by Friday?
On Wed, Jul 27, 2022 at 12:56 AM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hey Vera (I dropped Adam and Johnny from this thread, added Laura because of INSPIRES, and Nils from
RDMA),
I just had a call with RDMA and Internews today regarding the potential collaboration with YouTube as an add-or
to a newly awarded program that will work with journalists and creators that are reporting on disinformation in the
region.
Next week, Internews is aiming to come back to us with a concept and budget, which I assume we can
present to YouTube for discussion.
Let me know if we're OK with that --I'm happy to participate from Belgrade - which is actually a convenient spot
to talk both to Asia and DC.
Best,
Josh
On Thu, Jun 30, 2022 at 12:10 AM Vera Zakem <[contact omitted]> wrote:
+Johnny
+Adam
This is great. Many thanks. A few additional items.
1. We need to prioritize a few key countries globally (not just UKR) to pilot some literacy and other trainings,
and engagement with the missions. I want to understand the impact of these efforts and shape these
accordingly with them.
2. Opportunities for SP to do interviews with creators. Potential next up could be UNGA.
3. He owes us an answer on the Qs. From SP / Susan convo. Let's reshare those Qs with him.
I can send a note back.
TYSM
Vera
On Wed, Jun 29, 2022 at 5:04 PM Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Vera,
Here are my quick notes about the meeting with Josh Blumenfeld today:

• Josh heads up the Government Affairs Department, which has a small team and we can direct all
global inquiries related to YouTube to him. They want to work with USAID
• He is looking for "trusted flaggers" to be a part of their program. these are groups that understand
local context and language that can identify problematic content that YT or its automated systems
would not necessarily catch. (TO DO: we provided him list of Ukraine media observation groups;
we could prepare a select list of our country programs, that would list the implementing
partner and their local partners -- but we should consider a list of priority countries).
• YouTube provides social media / online literacy training programs for CSOs, primarily in the US. His
big "offers" for us to get back to him are:
• Trainings for our communicators (i.e. LPA and DOCs) on how to effectively use YouTube
• Funding a cohort of YouTube creators and or media outlets that use YouTube in their offerings
for equipping and training up on YouTube. Josh will draft up a short concept for us to look at.
We could make it a co-branded regional program or global program. They want to achieve this
by the end of this calendar year. (TO DO: A possible opportunity might be to latch this on
to the RDMA program for fact checkers in that region, that RDMA is currently
approving; another option might be to do something with creators in Ukraine and the
region. We need to decide this internally).
Let me know if you thinkI left out any essential points.
Best,
J
Josh Machleder (he / him/ his)
Senior Media and Internet Freedom Advisor
USAID | Center for Democracy, Human Rights and Governance
Office: [opaque block]
Email:[contact omitted]
N.B. Please note / work flexibly. I'm sending this message now because it suits my work hours. I don't
expect you to read or respond to this message outside of your usual hours.
